scenario: The negative half of LCST.4.3.4: casting an absent value raises nothing. The break is handing the null to the conversion adapter, which type-checks the kind and answers a type mismatch with no Json provenance, recorded as an EngineError, which latches the engine. None of the four fault kinds may appear here.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    f: Float? mutable

rule r:
    S s where (s.f::String?) is null
->
    log info "absent"
